implementation.behavior: A Signal requires a dated official row, eligible issued status, site, and an explicit supported facility grammar: data center or laboratory conversion/construction, major manufacturing remodel or construction, substantive warehouse construction, or substantive hospital construction. It rejects residential, routine, equipment-only, temporary/event, ordinary office/restaurant/retail/tenant, canceled or completed, and non-construction text.
implementation.rationale: Accepted rationale explicitly says to investigate construction or commissioning power needs and retains that permit issuance does not prove work start, load, or a power gap.
implementation.unknowns: Buyer, activity-specific power requirement, start window, duration, and suitable supply remain UNKNOWN; no Prospect or Lead result is emitted.

retained_sample_review.method: All retained rows were re-evaluated locally with the exact v2 evaluator; no network or database access.

failed_attempts.evidence: The first narrowed grammar still treated generic construct-alteration text as warehouse, plant, or hospital construction. Tests and the retained Seattle sample exposed it. The repaired grammar requires substantive construction for those categories while retaining explicit construct-warehouse phrasing.

limitations: This is a deliberately bounded grammar, not entity resolution or general NLP. Facility names do not establish project ownership, work start, load, duration, or supply. The review reflects retained samples dated 2026-09-27 and is not a coverage or runtime acceptance claim.
authority: No database writes, network calls, runtime restart, migration, API/UI changes, external communication, push, merge, or deployment. No self-acceptance.
